transcript: The prospect asked for something to share with the team. You sent a PDF. Here's why a narrated pitch deck makes the case when you're not there.
Sales slides are built to be presented. Without your voice, readers jump to pricing, your champion retells it from memory, and every slide gets the same weight.
Keep it short and specific to the buyer. Their situation, the problem, your answer, proof, then one clear ask. It mirrors how a buyer thinks.
Headlines should tell the story with the sound off. Your speaker notes become the narration, so write them the way you'd say them. If you trip, the narrator will too.
Many people watch forwarded videos with the sound off, so turn on burned-in captions. Then send a brief email that states the length and the ask.
Ordinary slides in, extraordinary pitch out. Try Basic with no subscription needed, or go Pro from A$29 a month and let a.i. direct your pitch. Visit powerpoint2vid.com.
